text:
Sam I: heads-up — provisioning failed for 6 new GPUs in us-west-2 when autoscaler tried to spin up nodes. Cloud API returns 429 on SG modifications.

deploy-bot: deploy failed: create-instances job 20250302-4321 → 1/6 succeeded, 5/6 errored. Error: `429 Too Many Requests: ModifySecurityGroupRules` :exclamation:

Sam I: error snippet:
```
ERROR: ModifySecurityGroupRules failed for sg-0a1b2c3d: RateLimitExceeded
Retry-After: 30
Trace: cloud_api_client.py:line 214
``` 

Maria G: do we have per-instance SG attachments? that's going to kill us if autoscaler scales quickly.

Aj Patel: checking infra code — yep, terraform module node_pool creates a unique SG per launch template. Not great.

Lee: cloud-support replied to our ticket: "Account has per-minute write limit on security group rule changes. To raise it we need a quota increase (case CLOUD-98512). ETA 48-72h." link: https://cloud.provider.support/cases/CLOUD-98512 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

cloud-ops: opened an internal ticket (OPS-341) to stop autoscaler from generating new SGs; recommending reuse of a shared nodepool-sg and reduce API churn.

Maria G: short-term mitigations?

Aj Patel: propose: 1) pre-create a pool of 20 SGs and assign at launch to avoid inline rule edits. 2) patch autoscaler template to pick existing SG from the pool. 3) add exponential backoff for SG updates.

Sam I: I'll hack a small controller to allocate/release SG from pool. Patch will be in a PR later today. Also will add per-account quota alert to monitoring.

Lee: long-term: separate heavy-provisioning accounts or dedicated project for large-scale transient jobs so quota isolation is better. Also log the cost diff.

Maria G: can someone add a quick postmortem if CLOUD-98512 not done by EOD Fri? I'll draft initial notes.

Sam I: temporary script uploaded to infra-scripts: `scripts/sg-pool-allocator.sh` — uses batch apply and respects `Retry-After`. Tested with staging — rolled 30 nodes w/o 429s.

deploy-bot: note: next rollout will be paused until PR merges and allocator is live.

Sam I: will follow up once quota increase confirmed. ping me for 3pm sync :calendar: :thumbsup:
